products.name: Loom AI
products.note: Async video AI; auto-chapters; summaries; transcription; Atlassian acquisition context

profile_text.body:
Loom is a screen recording and video messaging tool available for Mac and PC that, according to its own site, is trusted by over 22 million people. The company describes its product as a free online screen recorder with video editing and storage capabilities, designed to make it easy to record and share walkthroughs quickly.

Loom's AI product, Loom AI, extends the core recording tool with features including automatic chapters, summaries, and transcription. The site also highlights an integration with Jira, where a recorded walkthrough can be converted into a populated Jira work item, with Loom automatically capturing technical details such as device, browser, operating system, console errors, and network activity to help development teams triage issues. The held facts note Loom AI in the context of an Atlassian acquisition, which is consistent with the Jira workflow described on the site.
